title: Terlingua groundwater evidence map
distance_method: Haversine great-circle distance, mean Earth radius 3958.7613 statute miles; rounded town center

depth_summary.scope: Water-well source records excluding separate plugging reports; may include duplicate physical wells

limitations: Counts describe source records, not unique physical wells; SDR and GWDB can document the same well. Plugging reports may also refer to a mapped well report.
Positive yield is historical reported flow, including driller estimates; it does not establish present capacity, sustainable yield, or safe drinking water.
Dry status requires explicit source wording; zero, negative, missing, or unparsed yields alone are not treated as dry. Capped for possible re-entry alone is not a dry outcome.
Plugged/abandoned status does not by itself explain the reason. Dry and historical yield evidence are preserved even where a plugging status takes precedence.
Springs, observation sites, test holes, oil/gas holes and surface-water records occur in the source databases; record type is retained.
SDR coordinates are unverified and may be wrong. Source coordinate datums and uncertainty vary; recorded coordinates are used as exposed by the TWDB map service.
GWDB and SDR are incomplete inventories; failed holes and older reports may be missing. This dataset cannot establish a drilling success rate.
No predictive probability or new-well depth is estimated. Well density and nearby depth patterns are observational evidence only.
Public Texas records cover only part of the 50-mile circle, which extends into Mexico.
Historical yields in manually reviewed GWDB remarks are included with original wording and dates. Other unparsed narratives remain visible as source evidence; no missing value is imputed.

classification_rules.positive_yield: A structured WellTest value has a positive numeric value/strictly positive lower bound, or manually reviewed source remarks explicitly report positive historical flow; estimates and spring flows are identified.
classification_rules.dry: Explicit dry hole/well/borehole or dry water-level wording, or a WellTest yield value DRY.
classification_rules.plugged_abandoned: Official plugging record, linked plugging report, declared plugging, GWDB Plugged or Destroyed use, or manually reviewed explicit abandonment/closure evidence.
classification_rules.unknown: The retrieved evidence does not support one of the other categories.

snapshot_note: Snapshot timestamps come from source-download file modification times; rebuilding cached files does not imply a fresh retrieval.
